d=\min\left\{n\in\mathbb Z_{\ge2}:\text{there exists a uniform, non-homogeneous algebraic vector bundle on }\mathbb P^n_{\mathbb C}\text{ of some rank }1\le r<2n\right\},

137	\[

194	
195	N = 6

198	I = s.eye(N)
199

201	J = s.zeros(N)
202	for i, j in [(0, 1), (2, 3), (4, 5)]:
203	    J[i, j] = 1
204	    J[j, i] = -1
205	assert J.det() == 1
206

208	G = s.diag(2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)

210	assert JG[0, 1] == 2
211	assert JG[2, 3] == 1
212	assert JG[4, 5] == 1
213	
214	# Global degree-two Koszul sequence:
215	# wedge^2 V* -> V* tensor V* -> Sym^2 V*.
216	sym_pairs = pairs + [(i, i) for i in range(N)]
217	D = s.zeros(21, 36)
218	for i in range(N):
219	    for j in range(N):
220	        p = tuple(sorted((i, j)))
221	        D[sym_pairs.index(p), N*i + j] = 1
222	
223	K = s.zeros(36, 15)
224	for k, (i, j) in enumerate(pairs):
225	    K[N*i + j, k] = 1
226	    K[N*j + i, k] = -1
227	
228	assert D * K == s.zeros(21, 15)
229	assert K.rank() == 15
230	assert D.rank() == 21
231	assert 15 + 21 == 36
232	
233	# Coordinate hyperplanes force A on wedge^2 V* to be diagonal.
234	# The remaining hyperplanes force all 15 diagonal entries to agree.
235	relations = []
236	for i, k in combinations(range(N), 2):
237	    for j in range(N):
238	        if j in (i, k):
239	            continue
240	        row = [0] * 15
241	        row[index[tuple(sorted((i, j)))]] = 1
242	        row[index[tuple(sorted((k, j)))]] = -1
243	        relations.append(row)
244	
245	assert s.Matrix(relations).rank() == 14
246	
247	# Representatives of the two symplectic orbits of two-planes.
248	for name, U in [
249	    ("nonisotropic", s.Matrix.hstack(I[:, 0], I[:, 1])),
250	    ("isotropic",    s.Matrix.hstack(I[:, 0], I[:, 2])),
251	]:
252	    W = s.Matrix.hstack(*U.T.nullspace())
253	    restricted_rank = (W.T * J * W).rank()
254	    assert restricted_rank > 0
255	    print(name, restricted_rank)
256	
257	assert comb(5, 2) - 1 == 9
258	assert 9 < 2 * 5
259	
260	print("All exact finite linear-algebra checks passed.")
261	```
